en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Score 82 on 6h 58m, 23:33 to 06:37. Three points under last night's 85 and two minutes under the 7h 00m average — a middling night on the sleep column, and the best night on this board for everything else. Garmin graded it good. Start with the autonomics, because that is where the movement is. HRV came in at 45, up six from 39 and four over the 41 average — the second-highest reading of the seven behind Monday night's 49, and a full recovery of the ten points Tuesday's deadlift day cost you. RHR held 53 for a fourth consecutive night, one under the 54 baseline and tied for the lowest here. Average stress read 13, the lowest in the window against 26 the day before, and body battery charged to 94 yesterday, the highest ceiling of the seven. Four markers, all pointing the same way. That is what a full rest day buys: 43 active kcal and 2,249 steps on Wednesday, and Tuesday's autonomic bill cleared in a single day. The sleep itself was clean rather than long. Six minutes awake across the whole night, 99% efficiency, the second-lowest awake total on this board behind Sunday evening's zero, with awake count and restlessness both graded excellent. Stages: light 4h 27m at 64%, REM 1h 24m at 20%, deep 1h 07m at 16%. Deep and REM together made 2h 31m, 36% of the night — the lowest restorative share of the seven, and the reason the score sits at 82 rather than higher. Garmin flagged total duration and REM percentage as fair; nothing else was below good. The awake column still does the heavy lifting on this board: the 64-minute night produced the 65, 42 minutes produced 73, 20 minutes produced 79, and every night under 12 minutes awake scored 82 or better. You went to bed at 23:33, 75 minutes later than Tuesday's 22:18, and got 68 fewer minutes of sleep. That is the whole story of the score. The board has now shown it three times: your two earliest lights-out, 22:18 and 22:50, produced 8h 06m and 7h 39m; your two latest, 23:46 and 23:33, produced 6h 16m and 6h 58m. Bedtime, not sleep quality, is what sets duration here. Readiness 87, the highest of this block. HRV recovered, RHR at its floor, stress at its lowest, a rest day behind you — this is the green light for the hard session you held back on yesterday. Take it, then get the lights out closer to 22:30 tonight. The recovery is there; the hours are what you keep leaving on the table.

hr.c3d: isto kao sinoć (53) · -1 vs prosjek 7 noći (54)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Ocjena 82 uz 6h 58m, od 23:33 do 06:37. Tri boda ispod sinoćnjih 85 i dvije minute ispod prosjeka od 7h 00m — osrednja noć u stupcu sna, a najbolja noć na ovoj ploči po svemu ostalome. Garmin ju je ocijenio dobrom. Počni od autonomike, jer se tamo dogodio pomak. HRV je bio 45, šest više od 39 i četiri iznad prosjeka od 41 — drugo najviše očitanje od sedam, iza ponedjeljkovih 49, i potpun povrat deset bodova koje te koštao utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja. RHR se četvrtu noć zaredom zadržao na 53, jedan ispod osnovice od 54 i izjednačen s najnižim ovdje. Prosječni stres 13, najniži u prozoru naspram 26 dan ranije, a body battery se jučer napunio na 94, najviši strop od sedam. Četiri pokazatelja, svi u istom smjeru. To je ono što donese pravi dan odmora: 43 aktivne kcal i 2.249 koraka u srijedu, a utorkov autonomni račun podmiren u jednom danu. Sam san bio je čist, a ne dug. Šest minuta budnosti kroz cijelu noć, 99% učinkovitost, drugi najniži zbroj budnosti na ploči iza nedjeljne nule, uz broj buđenja i nemir ocijenjene izvrsnima. Faze: laki san 4h 27m i 64%, REM 1h 24m i 20%, duboki san 1h 07m i 16%. Duboki i REM zajedno dali su 2h 31m, 36% noći — najniži obnavljajući udio od sedam i razlog zašto je ocjena 82, a ne viša. Garmin je ukupno trajanje i udio REM-a označio kao osrednje; ništa drugo nije bilo ispod dobrog. Stupac budnosti i dalje nosi najviše: noć od 64 minute dala je 65, 42 minute dale su 73, 20 minuta dalo je 79, a svaka noć ispod 12 minuta budnosti dala je 82 ili više. Legao si u 23:33, 75 minuta kasnije od utorkovih 22:18, i dobio 68 minuta manje sna. To je cijela priča o ocjeni. Ploča je to sada pokazala tri puta: dva najranija gašenja svjetla, 22:18 i 22:50, dala su 8h 06m i 7h 39m; dva najkasnija, 23:46 i 23:33, dala su 6h 16m i 6h 58m. Trajanje ovdje određuje vrijeme lijeganja, a ne kvaliteta sna. Spremnost 87, najviša u ovom bloku. HRV oporavljen, RHR na dnu, stres najniži, dan odmora iza tebe — ovo je zeleno svjetlo za teški trening koji si jučer zadržao. Iskoristi ga, a onda večeras ugasi svjetlo bliže 22:30. Oporavak je tu; sati su ono što stalno ostavljaš na stolu.
